characters.summary: The Count is a vampire-themed Muppet who uses numerical compulsions, data manipulation, and musical cues to overwhelm opponents. He possesses superhuman abilities related to counting and can cause lightning and thunder storms whenever he counts.

techniques: Weather manipulation via counting (lightning and thunder)

weaknesses: Compulsive need to count objects, which can distract him
limitations: Distracted and compelled to stop tasks to count items.

sources.supports: Vampiric nature, counting-triggered weather manipulation, and compulsive counting.

feats.claim: Triggered a massive thunderstorm with continuous thunder and lightning by counting objects in the vicinity.

campaignTags.claim: Summons lightning and thunder storms when he counts.
Possesses supernatural vampire abilities and spells.

unknowns: Full combat efficacy against non-numerical opponents remains unspecified.

characters.summary: The Newsman is a television news reporter who specializes in delivering breaking news updates, often finding himself caught in hazardous physical comedy scenarios. He fights primarily with journalistic persistence and observational commentary.

sources.supports: Role as a reporter on The Muppet Show enduring frequent physical mishaps.

feats.claim: Consistently delivered live news reports while objects exploded or fell around him on The Muppet Show.

unknowns: Combat capabilities outside of broadcasting environments are unknown.

characters.summary: Thog is an exceptionally large, gentle blue monster who uses his massive physical size and strength to dominate close-quarters encounters. Despite his intimidating stature, he is generally mild-mannered.

mechanisms: High physical durability due to giant size

weaknesses: Gentle disposition makes him reluctant to fight aggressively
mobility: Standard foot movement with heavy strides

sources.supports: Physical size and friendly personality on The Muppet Show.

feats.claim: Stood out as one of the tallest characters on The Muppet Show, dwarfing human guests and fellow Muppets.

unknowns: Combat feats against serious combatants are absent.
Unsupported by cited source (term check, 2/7 key terms found): giant-sized: Stands significantly taller than standard Muppets, towering over the cast.

characters.summary: The Two-Headed Monster consists of two heads sharing a single large furry body, often arguing over direction while exerting coordinated physical strength. They tackle challenges through cooperative or competing pulls and pushes.

mechanisms: Shared mass and redundant processing from two heads

weaknesses: Prone to internal disagreement that can stall actions

sources.supports: Characteristics of the two heads operating a single body on Sesame Street.

unknowns: Performance under structured combat tactics is unverified.
Unsupported by cited source (term check, 2/10 key terms found): Successfully manipulated heavy objects by coordinating pushes from both heads in opposite or aligned directions.

characters.summary: Uncle Deadly is a theatrical, dragon-like phantom monster who uses dramatic flair, stealth, and intimidation tactics. He acts as a menacing presence capable of sabotage and dramatic flair in confrontations.
limitations: Relies heavily on dramatic effect rather than direct combat efficiency.

sources.supports: Role as the Phantom of the Muppet Show and subsequent appearances emphasizing theatrical menace.

campaignTags.claim: Operates as a phantom capable of sudden stealthy appearances and disappearances.

unknowns: Direct engagement combat limits against armed opponents are unknown.
Unsupported by cited source (term check, 3/8 key terms found): Haunted the Muppet Theater, using shadows and hidden passageways to surprise the cast.

characters.summary: Uncle Traveling Matt is an intrepid explorer who ventures into 'Outer Space' (the human world), relying on resilience, survival gear, and sheer observational curiosity to navigate hostile environments.
weaknesses: Prone to misinterpreting ordinary human objects as dangerous traps
limitations: Physical strength is comparable to an average Fraggle.

sources.supports: Role as an explorer in Fraggle Rock venturing into human domains.

campaignTags.claim: Uses various human-world items and makeshift explorer equipment.

unknowns: Combat capabilities against hostile fictional monsters are untested.
Unsupported by cited source (term check, 4/11 key terms found): Navigated perilous human environments such as workshops, houses, and vehicles across multiple seasons of Fraggle Rock.

characters.summary: Waldorf is an elderly balcony heckler who fights primarily with scathing verbal wit, insults, and sharp observational baroom humor alongside his companion Statler.
weaknesses: Advanced age limits physical mobility and durability
limitations: Physically frail and bound to theater seating.

sources.supports: Role as balcony heckler on The Muppet Show.

feats.claim: Undermined the morale of entire theater casts through continuous precise comedic insults from the balcony.

characters.summary: Walter is an enthusiastic, lifelong Muppet fan whose deep knowledge of Muppet history and unexpected emotional resonance allows him to support his allies and occasionally execute synchronized musical maneuvers.
limitations: Average human-equivalent physical strength for a Muppet.

sources.supports: Role as a main protagonist in the 2011 film The Muppets.

feats.claim: Performed a synchronized finger-whistling solo that captivated a packed theater audience.

unknowns: Direct solo combat feats against hostile entities are unrecorded.

characters.summary: Wembley Fraggle is an energetic, indecisive, but highly agile explorer who relies on quick reflexes, tight spaces, and collaborative problem-solving to evade danger.
mobility: Acquired running, jumping, and tunnel crawling
limitations: Easily frightened and hesitant in combat situations.

sources.supports: Personality traits and physical escapades in Fraggle Rock.

unknowns: Unsupported by cited source (term check, 2/10 key terms found): Successfully navigated labyrinthine cave systems and avoided Gorg captures through rapid scrambling.

characters.summary: Zoe is a spirited, energetic young monster who uses high-energy acrobatics, passionate determination, and imaginative play to overcome obstacles.

sources.supports: Traits, energetic disposition, and activities on Sesame Street.

feats.claim: Executed complex dance routines and high-energy gymnastic maneuvers across Sesame Street segments.
